facts.text: Andaz Bali is a beachfront resort in Sanur.
facts.excerpt: This luxe beachfront resort—a modern interpretation of a Balinese village—in Sanur

facts.text: The resort is designed as a modern interpretation of a Balinese village.
facts.excerpt: a modern interpretation of a Balinese village

facts.text: The resort was built around the natural landscape.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Bali has been carefully built around the lush natural landscape

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas are spread around clusters of courtyards.
facts.excerpt: rooms, suites and villas are spread around clusters of courtyards, each with its own character and charm

facts.text: Rooms and suites have a spacious balcony.
facts.excerpt: Rooms and suites boast a spacious balcony

facts.text: Lagoon Access rooms lead to the lagoon pool.
facts.excerpt: Relax your mind and body in your own private oasis that leads to the serene lagoon pool.

facts.text: Garden Pool Villas have a private garden with a pool.
facts.excerpt: recharge on a sunbed by the pool in your lush private garden

facts.text: Garden Pool Villas blend traditional Balinese craftsmanship with contemporary touches.
facts.excerpt: featuring a blend of traditional Balinese craftsmanship and contemporary touches

facts.text: Villa stays include personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: in-villa check-in, along with personalized butler service, a complimentary minibar

facts.text: The two-bedroom Beach Pool Villa is steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: This lavish two-bedroom villa just steps from the beach combines all the comforts of a modern home with Balinese interior décor.

facts.text: The Beach Pool Villa can be connected to the Beach Villa next door to create a four-bedroom villa.
facts.excerpt: This villa can be connected to the Beach Villa next door to create a four-bedroom villa.

facts.text: Fisherman's Club is a beachfront restaurant serving the catch of the day from local fishermen, grilled on coconut husks the traditional way.
facts.excerpt: the freshest seafood catch of the day by local fishermen, grilled on coconut husks the traditional way

facts.text: Village Square, in the heart of the resort, has four intertwining restaurants.
facts.excerpt: The dining experience starts in the heart of the resort at Village Square, with four intertwining restaurants

facts.text: The resort has Shankha Spa.
facts.excerpt: Shankha Spa

facts.text: The resort has a kids club called Kemu Mai.
facts.excerpt: Kemu Mai - Kids Club

facts.text: The resort has a Sea Turtle Village Conservation Program.
facts.excerpt: Sea Turtle Village Conservation Program

facts.text: Ngurah Rai International Airport is about 14.6 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)14.6 kilometers

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary valet parking is available at Andaz Bali.

facts.text: Pets are not permitted.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted at Andaz Bali.

facts.text: Rooms include an oversized bathroom with rain shower and soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: an oversized bathroom with rain shower and soaking tub
